item.title: Special: MVI Deep Dive
item.description:
A full-depth episode on Model-View-Intent: the unidirectional loop, pure reducers, effect handlers, platform state holders, replay debugging, testing, and sharing MVI across iOS and Android through Kotlin Multiplatform.

Chapters

  • 00:00 — Cold open
  • 00:25 — The loop, precisely
  • 01:40 — Reducers as pure functions
  • 03:00 — Side effects, the honest part
  • 04:40 — State holders on Android
  • 06:05 — State holders on iOS
  • 07:15 — Replay and time-travel
  • 08:25 — Testing the loop
  • 09:40 — The KMP angle
  • 10:45 — When MVI hurts
  • 12:00 — Takeaway

Topics mentioned in this episode

  • StateFlow — Kotlin coroutines docs
  • Unidirectional data flow & state hoisting — Android UI layer guide
  • Observation framework — Apple Developer
  • The Composable Architecture — Point-Free
  • Turbine — flow testing for Kotlin
  • Kotlin Multiplatform — JetBrains

item.title: Ep 1: Architecture Patterns — Choosing Like a Staff Engineer
item.description:
Maya and Jordan walk through MVC, MVVM, MVI, and the Composable Architecture — not as a textbook tour, but through the Staff-level lens: which pattern earns its complexity for a given team, app, and trajectory, across iOS and Android.

Chapters

  • 00:00 — Cold open
  • 00:44 — Why patterns matter at Staff scope
  • 01:55 — MVC and why mobile outgrew it
  • 02:55 — MVVM, the workhorse
  • 04:18 — MVI and unidirectional data flow
  • 05:29 — TCA, the strict end of the spectrum
  • 06:57 — The Staff judgment call
  • 08:28 — Takeaway
